## Interpretive Ambiguities

### 1. "Business Day" Application
**Narrow Interpretation**: Excludes only Saturdays, Sundays, English public holidays
**Broad Interpretation**: May include additional non-working days or jurisdiction-specific holidays
**Impact**: Affects all time-sensitive obligations (payments, notices, claims)
**Recommendation**: Adopt narrow interpretation with explicit definition

### 2. Claim Notification "Awareness" Standard
**Subjective Standard**: "becomes aware" (actual knowledge)
**Objective Standard**: "ought reasonably to have become aware" (constructive knowledge)
**SPA Wording**: Includes both standards ("becomes aware, or ought reasonably to have become aware")
**Risk**: Dual standard may shorten claim period
**Recommendation**: Retain dual standard for Buyer protection
